notes.title: Minor Update 1.1 - March 4, 2024
notes.content:
[u][b]Made a couple of minor updates based on feedback from players:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed the spectate system:[/b] If you die early in an online match, you will automatically start spectating the nearest player rather than having your viewpoint stuck.
[*] [b]Minor UI Tweaks:[/b] Made some minor tweaks to the "Map Transition" UI, aimed at making the information clearer.
[*] [b]Installation Bug Fix for Linux Users:[/b] Fixed unnecessarily large installation size for native Linux users.
[/list]
Have fun and keep blastin'!
